lines.en: I make my way over to the pool because it might be the only opportunity I ever get to see Karin wet.
lines.zh: 我去了游泳池，因为这可能是我唯一能见到浑身湿透的 Karin 的机会。

lines.en: Unfortunately, it seems like today won't be the day for that either as she feels weird about swimming so long as I'm present.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，今天看来也不是那一天——只要我在场，她就觉得游泳怪别扭的。

lines.en: As such, the two of us retreat to a bench where she tells me all about the wholesome things she's been doing as a whole, while peppering in comments about how I should return to school.
lines.zh: 于是我们俩退到一张长椅上，她跟我说起她最近做的各种健康向上的事，其间还时不时插几句让我回学校的话。

lines.en: I'm not sure what she would gain from that even if I did given that she's never been a student of mine. But I humor her regardless because it's easier than telling the truth.
lines.zh: 我也不明白她能从中得到什么——她从来就不是我的学生。但我还是顺着她，因为这比说出真相容易多了。

lines.en: And I'm not about to sit here and explain to a girl that probably doesn't even know what a penis looks like that I fucked one of her underclassmen out of existence.
lines.zh: 我总不至于坐在这里，跟一个大概连阴茎长什么样都不知道的女孩解释，我把她的一个学妹操到从这世上消失了。

lines.en: It would have been nice if I was the one to have disappeared instead. But hey, maybe that's how it will turn out if I ever truly {i}fall{/i} for someone else.
lines.zh: 要是消失的是我就好了。不过话说回来，要是我真的{i}爱上{/i}别人，结局大概也会是这样。

lines.en: Imagine that person winds up being Karin. Imagine what sort of toll would be taken on {i}her{/i} mind if she lost her virginity only to find herself alone and quivering on some cold rooftop.
lines.zh: 想象一下，那个人最后是 Karin。想象一下，如果她献出初夜之后，却发现自己孤零零地哆嗦在某个冰冷的天台上，{i}她的{/i}精神会受到怎样的摧残。

lines.en: I bet she'd never want to have sex again.
lines.zh: 我敢打赌，她这辈子都不会再想做爱了。

lines.en: Sometimes, I feel like I don't either.
lines.zh: 有时候，我觉得我也不想了。

lines.en: But I tell myself I'm wrong so I can keep coming to places like this- where I can convince myself it isn't over yet.
lines.zh: 但我告诉自己我错了，好让自己还能继续来这种地方——在这里我可以说服自己，一切都还没结束。

lines.en: But I know that, deep down, it is.
lines.zh: 但我心里清楚，早就结束了。
